CQC registration support that is complete from the start.

Many new providers underestimate how much work is involved in CQC registration. It is not just an online form. CQC will expect your application, Statement of Purpose, policies, governance arrangements and supporting documents to show how your service will operate safely and effectively from day one.

That is why our registration package is built around one simple principle:

The essentials should be included, not sold as extras.

For a flat £2,500 fee, we help prepare a full registration application pack that is clear, detailed, service-specific and aligned with how your business will actually operate.

Book a FREE CQC Registration Call

A complete 360 degree registration package

CQC application preparation and completion support

We support the preparation and completion of your CQC registration application, including provider and registered manager application materials, where relevant. We also support additional service-specific forms where required, including personal care, homecare, supported living, learning disability and autism-related application requirements.

Business plan support where needed

Where CQC requires a business plan or financial forecast, we can prepare this as part of the fixed-fee registration package.

Statement of Purpose

We prepare a detailed Statement of Purpose that clearly explains what your service does, where it operates, who it supports, which regulated activities it provides and how the service will be managed.

Mock fit person interview preparation

We prepare registered managers and nominated individuals for CQC interview questions, including governance, safeguarding, staffing, quality assurance, risk management, regulations and service delivery.

Bespoke mandatory CQC policies

We prepare the policies CQC requires for registration, tailored from the ground up to your actual service model, staffing arrangements, governance systems, regulated activities and client group.

We do not rely on generic templates or proformas that fail to reflect how your service will actually operate.

Assessment-stage documents

If CQC asks for further documents during the assessment stage, we help prepare and refine the documents needed to respond properly.

Unlimited consultancy during registration

You are not left alone once the documents are drafted. We provide ongoing advice throughout the registration process, including support with CQC questions, requests for clarification and practical issues that arise during assessment.

Reapplication amendments included

If CQC rejects the application, we provide reapplication amendments at no extra charge. This gives new providers reassurance that they will not be charged again for changes that form part of the same registration journey.

Bespoke policies, not off-the-shelf templates.

Generic CQC policy packs can create problems when they do not match the service being registered.

CQC wants to understand how your business will actually operate. A homecare provider, supported living service, care home, clinic or specialist service will each need documents that reflect its own regulated activities, staffing model, governance systems, risks and client group.

Our policy work is therefore built around your service. We write policies to show how your organisation will meet CQC expectations in practice, not just how a template says a provider might operate in theory.

Remote and On-Site CQC Mock Inspections.

Already registered?

We also provide remote and on-site CQC mock inspections for providers who want to understand their compliance position before CQC does.

Our remote mock inspection service is particularly useful for smaller providers who want cost-effective external assurance without the cost of a full on-site review. We can review governance evidence, policies, audits, care documentation, training records and inspection-readiness remotely, then provide a clear action plan.

FAQs

5

How much does your CQC registration package cost?

1

Our full CQC registration package is a flat £2,500 fee. This includes application preparation and completion support, Statement of Purpose, bespoke policies, business plan support where needed, unlimited consultancy, mock fit person interview preparation, assessment-stage documents and reapplication amendments if CQC rejects the application.

Do you charge extra for policies, business plans or interview preparation?

2

No. Where these are needed for your registration, they are included in the fixed £2,500 package.

Do you use CQC policy templates?

3

No. We prepare policies around your actual service model, regulated activities, staffing, governance arrangements and operational risks.

Can you help if my CQC application has already been rejected?

4

Yes. We can review the rejected application, identify the likely weaknesses and support a stronger reapplication.

Do you offer remote CQC mock inspections?

Yes. We provide remote and on-site mock inspections. Remote mock inspections are a cost-effective option for smaller providers who want practical compliance assurance without a full site visit.
